About Us
POLITICO illuminates the forces shaping global power. Since 2007, we have delivered intelligence that anticipates tomorrow's headlines, not reports on yesterday's news. As politics has increasingly become the defining force of our era, our work has never been more vital.
Cabinet secretaries and Ministers start their mornings with our analysis. CEOs shape strategy around our reporting. Advocacy leaders rely on our insights to move policy. We deliver the straightforward facts and clear-eyed analysis they need to navigate the most complex political landscape of our lifetimes.
Our 1,100+ publishing professionals across the world's key democratic capitals—Washington, Brussels, London, Paris, Berlin, Sacramento, and New York—form the world's premier politics and policy newsroom. We tell the story of how power really works by explaining who wields it and how they plan to exercise it, connecting dots others miss and delivering scoops from sources others don't even know exist.
Innovation has always been a core tenet of our story. At launch, we bet that depth would trump scale, that talent would trump traffic, and that politics would become central to modern life. In 2011, we made another bet and launched POLITICO Pro to help decision-makers understand the business of government, transforming both how they shape government action and the business of journalism itself.
These bets have made POLITICO the most successful digital news startup of its generation and the indispensable resource for leaders who shape the future. Today, we are a rarity in media: a growing, profitable, and sustainable news organization.
POLITICO is a subsidiary of Axel Springer SE, a family-owned transatlantic media company headquartered in Berlin and New York. Axel Springer is dedicated to shaping the future of journalism in the free world, believing that a free and informed society is essential to democracy. The company’s guiding principles - first articulated as  The Essentials by founder Axel Springer in the aftermath of World War II - remain a cornerstone of the company’s foundation today. Learn more about Axel Springer.

Job Title: Senior Software Engineer (Match AI & Simulation)
Team: Match

Working Model: Hybrid 2-3 days | Remote by exception

Position Overview
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer (Match AI & Simulation) to join our London-based studio to enhance our match simulation and help us take our football match engine to the next level. The match engine team is responsible for the technological advancements of our state-of-the-art in-house engine which simulates football matches.
You will join a passionate and flourishing team who care deeply about the authenticity and depth of the match simulation in our games. As part of this team, you will be working on the game AI and core systems that drive our match simulation, which is used across multiple projects and products. This covers everything from the AI that controls the agents on the pitch, their decision-making, positioning, and tactical behaviours through to the rules of the simulation, pathing, collisions, and game state management.
Your primary focus will be on improving the architecture and performance of the match simulation, with particular emphasis on the game AI systems that drive agent behaviour. You will refactor existing systems from flat, tightly coupled structures into modern, maintainable paradigms such as behaviour trees, finite state machines, and utility-based systems. You will also build and maintain our in-house debugging and visualisation tools to ensure designers and engineers can rapidly iterate on and understand AI-driven agent behaviour.
You will collaborate closely with designers, QA, producers, and other engineering teams in a studio where football expertise runs, giving you rich, authentic context to draw on as you build the systems that power the simulation. You will have full input into the team specifically as well as the studio generally, with the opportunity to voice your ideas and suggestions.
Our match simulation is shared across multiple products and is a critical part of the games we make, and you will consider challenges involving the match experience across several platforms, including on mobile devices.
We are looking for self-motivated, proactive people with good communication skills who can complete work independently as well as part of a team, and who actively seek out opportunities to improve systems and drive change rather than waiting for direction.
Key Responsibilities
•
Develop, extend, improve, and maintain our match simulation codebase, workflows, and tools.
•
Design and implement game AI systems for match agents, including decision-making, positioning, rules enforcement, and tactical behaviours, using techniques such as behaviour trees, finite state machines, utility-based systems, and other classical video-game AI approaches.
•
Refactor and modernise AI-driven agent decision-making systems, moving from flat, monolithic class structures into modern, maintainable game AI architectures.
•
Build and maintain debugging and visualisation tools using our in-house ImGUI-based tooling to support rapid iteration and clear understanding of agent AI behaviour.
•
Collaborate with other disciplines, including designers, QA, producers, and other engineering teams, on both development and future planning.
•
Work closely with seniors/leads and production to drive new features and set the long-term roadmap.
•
Help research and implement new simulation technologies, game AI techniques, and architectural patterns as needed.
•
Consider cross-platform and performance requirements, including the need for deterministic simulation across platforms.
Knowledge, Skills, and Experience
•
Keen interest and understanding in Football. Football Manager fan a bonus.
•
Strong knowledge of C++, design patterns and software engineering.
•
Minimum five years of professional experience using C++ as the main language.
•
Professional experience designing and developing game AI systems and simulation paradigms within the games industry, including hands-on work with behaviour trees, finite state machines, utility-based systems, or similar classical video-game AI techniques.
•
Strong mathematical, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
•
Good communication skills for effective collaboration with software engineers, designers, QA, and production staff.

Self-motivated and proactive with a drive to improve yourself, seize ownership, and push systems forward rather than waiting for direction.

• Develop strategic selling approaches using marketing tools and resources to enhance client engagement and the SkinHealth Systems capital purchase experience.

• Transition new clients smoothly to the Regional Training Specialist and Business Development Manager, ensuring continuity of the client experience post-sale.
• Identify trade-up, second-system, and multi-location opportunities within the existing customer base in partnership with the Business Development team.
• Attend and represent Hydrafacial and SkinHealth Systems at local trade shows, regional events, and national sales meetings.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

Required
• High school diploma or GED.
• Minimum 3 years of medical device sales or capital equipment sales experience.

Founded in 1956, WJE is an interdisciplinary firm of over 600 engineers, architects, and materials scientists committed to helping clients solve, repair, and avoid challenging problems in the built world. With projects across the Americas, the United Kingdom, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia, our project teams comprise of internationally recognized industry leaders, known for our principles-first, hands-on, problem-solving approach.

The materials scientists and engineers of the Janney Technical Center – WJE’s US-based, state-of-the-art testing and applied research facility – employ a full array of chemistry, petrography, metallurgy, concrete and mortar, corrosion, environmental exposure, and structural testing capabilities.

10 or more years of relevant industry experience

• Meeting and exceeding performance targets and Key Performance Indicators (KPIs).
Working Together
• Collaborating with participants to shift their mindset and build the confidence they need to find and sustain work.

Being Fair, Open, and Honest
• Providing inclusive support and advice to people from all backgrounds.

Good medicine, genuine clinical autonomy and a team you can lean on without sacrificing your life outside work. At Colne Valley, you'll enjoy a varied consulting and surgical caseload, colleagues to learn from and a four-day working week that puts work-life balance first.
Why join us?
• A four-day week that works for you. Work 40 hours over four days, with a fixed day off to help you plan life outside work. The weekend rota is one in six, usually Saturday mornings from 8:30am to 1pm, with an additional Friday off after your weekend rota.
• A genuinely varied caseload. Typically split your week between two consulting days and two theatre days, giving you the opportunity to enjoy both sides of first-opinion practice.
• Clinical autonomy, with support when you need it. Take ownership of your cases and clinical decisions, knowing you have experienced colleagues around you to discuss cases and share ideas. We aim to have around seven vets working each day, so you're never left to figure everything out alone.
• Room to develop your interests. Whether you're considering a certificate or keen to build your confidence in a particular area, we'll encourage your ambitions and support your ongoing development. You don't need a specialism or bias to join us.
• The equipment and people to support good medicine. Work with modern diagnostic equipment, a strong nursing team and colleagues with a range of clinical interests, including imaging and exotics.
The team and practice
An experienced team, genuine clinical support and room to make your mark.
Colne Valley has been caring for pets in the Colchester community for over 75 years, and you'll be joining an established team of 10 vets, 11 nurses and a Clinical Nurse Manager. With this appointment bringing the veterinary team to 11, you'll be part of a substantial, collaborative group with a wealth of experience to draw on. Our team includes a vet with a radiology certificate, another nearing completion of their radiology studies, a colleague working towards a surgery certificate, and vets with interests in imaging and exotics. We aim to have around seven vets working on a typical day, giving you colleagues to discuss cases with, exchange ideas and learn from. You'll have the independence to take ownership of your cases and clinical decisions, without feeling that you have to work everything out alone.
A varied caseload, with the facilities and expertise to keep developing.
This isn't a role where you'll be limited to routine consultations. Your week will typically be split between two consulting days and two theatre days, giving you the opportunity to enjoy both medical and surgical work. Our purpose-built practice has five consulting rooms, a dedicated surgical theatre, a separate exotics ward, digital X-ray, ultrasound and three different types of endoscope. Whether you're keen to build on your existing skills, explore a new clinical interest or work towards a further qualification, you'll have colleagues to learn from and support to help you progress. We actively encourage further qualifications and professional development, so you don't need to arrive with a certificate or a particular specialism already in place.
We're investing in the team, not just the equipment.
We're also opening a new Client Care Manager role to strengthen the client experience and take pressure off the wider practice team. By giving client satisfaction and associated administrative responsibilities dedicated attention, the aim is to reduce the burden on clinical colleagues and the Practice Manager to allow them to focus more of their time and energy on patient care and their duties to keep clients, patients and staff happy. It's a positive step towards supporting the people who work here, improving the experience for clients and helping the practice continue delivering the standard of care it is known for.
A working pattern designed around life outside the practice.
Work-life balance is one of Colne Valley's biggest priorities. You'll work 40 hours across four days, with a fixed day off, giving you more consistency when planning your time outside work. The weekend rota is one in six, involving only Saturday mornings from 8:30am to 1pm, with an additional Friday off after your weekend. There is no routine out-of-hours rota, although occasional attendance may be needed for specific patient-care requirements on a Sunday (if it's your weekend to work), but this is more an exception as opposed to a rule. The aim is to give you a rewarding clinical role without work taking over your life.
An established local practice in a well-connected location.
Alongside the main practice, Colne Valley has an established consulting branch in Wivenhoe, helping us serve the surrounding community. Colchester itself offers plenty to enjoy beyond work, from its historic character to the coast around 20 minutes away. Direct trains to London take approximately 45 minutes, making it a great base if you want access to the countryside and coast without losing the convenience of the capital.

• A Veterinary Surgeon with at least 3 years experience, including a minimum of 18 months working in the UK.
• Confidence managing a varied first-opinion caseload and taking ownership of your cases.
• An interest in both consulting and surgery, with a commitment to delivering high-quality patient care.
• A collaborative approach and the confidence to work independently while knowing when to seek a second opinion.
• A desire to keep learning and developing clinically. Further qualifications are encouraged, but no particular certificate or specialism is required.

Our Private Client Tax team provides bespoke advisory and compliance services to ultra and high net worth individuals, entrepreneurs, family offices, business owners and senior executives. Whether clients require assistance with UK tax compliance, international structuring, succession planning or complex cross-border matters, we combine deep technical expertise with the strength of our global network to deliver integrated solutions across multiple jurisdictions. • Residence, domicile and cross-border mobility planning
• Business succession and exit planning
• Estate, inheritance tax and succession planning
• Trust structuring and family wealth governance
• Real estate ownership and investment structuring
• Philanthropy and charitable giving strategies

• Prepare proposals and fee budgets for new enquiries.

• Review tax returns and other compliance matters for high net worth and ultra-high net worth individuals.

• Professional qualifications such as ACA / ACCA / ATT / STEP and CTA, or equivalent.

Mattioli Woods is seeking an experienced Enterprise Architect to define the technical direction of a growing, acquisition-led wealth management group. This is a senior appointment with real strategic weight — you will own the target architecture for the Group, shape multi-million-pound platform decisions, and bring coherence to a technology landscape built across more than seven acquisitions.
This is not a governance or advisory role. We are looking for someone who combines architectural vision with the credibility to work alongside engineers, technology teams and strategic vendors to see decisions through to delivery. If you thrive on simplifying complexity, making consequential choices and building something that endures, we would welcome a conversation.
What you'll be doing
• Define the single target enterprise architecture for the Group and a practical roadmap to rationalise a technology landscape created through 7+ acquisitions
• Shape major strategic technology decisions, including the future client portal, SIPP SaaS platform and the long-term future of core platforms such as Xplan
• Establish architectural patterns and integration standards that allow AI — including emerging agentic capabilities — to work safely with core systems, data and business workflows
• Define and embed pragmatic architecture principles, governance and technology standards adopted consistently across the Group
• Work hands-on with engineering teams, technology partners and strategic vendors to guide implementation and ensure delivery follows architectural intent
• Communicate complex technology choices clearly to the CIO, ExCo and senior business leaders, including supporting technology due diligence for future acquisitions
What we're looking for
• Proven experience leading meaningful architecture and simplification in a complex organisation, ideally one shaped by acquisitions
• The ability to combine long-term strategic direction with delivery credibility — equally comfortable setting a multi-year roadmap and getting into a platform or integration discussion when needed
• Strong capability across business, application, integration, data, infrastructure and AI architecture, with the breadth to make good decisions across each domain
• Experience in regulated financial services or another complex regulated environment; wealth management background is advantageous but not essential

• A pragmatic, decisive approach: someone who simplifies rather than elaborates, makes clear recommendations and drives them through to completion
Why join us
Mattioli Woods presents a genuinely unusual architecture challenge: a business with real scale, continued acquisition activity and a clear mandate from the CIO and ExCo to rationalise and modernise. You will not be maintaining someone else's blueprint — you will be defining one from the ground up, with the authority and sponsorship to make it stick.
The scope of the role is broad by design. How does this role contribute to our collective success?
The Pricing function supports underwriters and management in building robust and profitable portfolios by providing objective insights through deep product expertise.
This role supports underwriting teams managing multi-line portfolios across delegated authority, portfolio-based, and structured capacity arrangements. Working closely with underwriters, you will provide pricing expertise to assess opportunities, monitor portfolio performance, and support underwriting decisions. The role offers exposure to a diverse range of portfolio structures, capacity solutions, and alternative capital initiatives, providing the opportunity to work on some of the most sophisticated insurance arrangements in the London Market.
What will you do in this role?
This role will:
•    Own end to end pricing for complex, high value, multi class portfolio deals, partnering across product teams to assess risk, return, and capital efficiency, and deliver clear recommendations on deal structure, pricing adequacy, and portfolio mix.
•    Partner with underwriters to design and optimise portfolio structures, including attachment points, limits, and the use of traditional reinsurance and alternative capital solutions, and act as a senior pricing partner across underwriting, exposure, reserving, capital modelling, and finance.
•    Deliver regular portfolio and product monitoring analyses to identify issues and opportunities, and support the design, execution, and tracking of portfolio action plans with underwriting teams.
•    Analyse rate change, price adequacy, exposure growth, market conditions, competitive dynamics, and loss trends, clearly articulating drivers of portfolio performance.
•    Maintain and enhance benchmarks and portfolio metrics, working closely with Product Pricing and Analytics teams, and support the ongoing development of pricing tools, models, data flows, and analytical capabilities.

•    Provide technical guidance, mentoring, and informal leadership to Portfolio Pricing Actuaries and Analysts.

•    Strong Excel and SQL skills; VBA, R, or Python advantageous.
•    Experience influencing underwriting strategy without formal authority.
•    An interest in developing junior actuaries.

2 years. Three rotations.

Help improve performance and wellbeing by improving how we work and make decisions

Conduct applied research and lead projects to uncover what drives performance

Create frameworks and guidance that make way for occupational psychology to be used throughout the business

Let’s go on an adventure together!

You won’t sit behind a desk.
You won’t have two days that look the same.
You won’t just be guiding tours.
You’ll be creating moments travellers talk about for the rest of their lives — while helping the people and places you visit, too.

As a Power Platform Engineer at Avanade, you will build complex, enterprise scale solutions using Microsoft Power Platform to solve our clients’ biggest problems. You will translate requirements into high quality, production ready applications and automations, working closely with architects, business analysts, testers and client stakeholders to deliver outcomes that matter.
This is a hands on engineering role with a strong delivery focus. You will apply sound engineering practices across the full solution lifecycle including design, build, test, release and support, while ensuring robust application lifecycle management, security and data modelling. Experience with Copilot Studio is preferred; if you do not have this today, this role is a great opportunity to learn and get experience with Copilot Studio and the latest Microsoft AI technologies.
Role Responsibilities
• Build and enhance enterprise scale solutions using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps (canvas and model driven), Power Automate, Dataverse and AI Builder.
• Work with solution architects and technical leads to implement agreed designs and ensure alignment with security, governance, scalability and operational standards.
• Collaborate with business analysts and client stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into functional, user friendly solutions.
• Partner with testers and quality engineers to plan and execute testing, resolve defects and ensure solutions meet functional and non functional requirements.
• Design and implement Dataverse data models, including tables, relationships, business rules and security roles appropriate for enterprise solutions.
• Implement security best practices across the platform, including role based access, environment controls and data protection considerations.
• Build integrations using standard, premium and custom connectors, and design API based integration patterns where required.
• Where appropriate, use Azure services including Azure Functions to extend Power Platform solutions and support more complex integration or processing needs.
• Apply application lifecycle management practices for Power Platform, including solution packaging, environment strategy, deployment approaches and release management.
• Identify opportunities to improve existing processes and solutions, proposing pragmatic enhancements focused on quality, performance and maintainability.
• Stay current with Power Platform capabilities and contribute to knowledge sharing within delivery teams and wider communities of practice.
• Where required, support pre sales activities through technical input, demonstrations and proof of concept development.
.
Required Skills and Experience
• Hands on experience building solutions with Microsoft Power Platform.
• Microsoft Power Platform certifications are desirable.
• Experience working in consulting or professional services environments.
• Experience considering performance, reliability and operational support for enterprise scale solutions.
• Familiarity with enterprise governance approaches and Centre of Excellence patterns for Power Platform.
• Experience with Copilot Studio is preferred. If not currently held, a willingness to upskill over time is expected.
Preferred Skills and Experience
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain technical decisions and trade offs to both technical and non technical audiences.
• Experience working collaboratively with architects, business analysts, testers and other engineers within multidisciplinary delivery teams.
• Ability to work from requirements through to functional implementation, including configuration, build, testing and support.
• Experience extending Power Platform solutions using Azure services such as Azure Functions where appropriate.
• Experience integrating solutions using standard and premium connectors, and building and maintaining custom connectors where needed.
• Experience implementing application lifecycle management practices for Power Platform, covering environments, solutions and deployment processes.
• Experience using AI Builder to add intelligent capabilities to Power Platform solutions.
• Experience working with Dataverse, including enterprise level data modelling and security roles.
• Strong delivery experience with Power Apps (canvas and model driven) and Power Automate.
Enjoy your career

•

Build your expertise, solve problems, learn, and develop
